text: To whom it may concern. This certifies employment as a Quality Control Inspector at a heavy steel fabrication plant. Duties: performing visual, ultrasonic and radiographic non-destructive testing of welded joints; calibrating and operating NDT inspection equipment; interpreting radiographs and test readouts; reviewing material test certificates (MTCs) for incoming steel; witnessing and monitoring welding activities for code compliance; and preparing detailed inspection reports against applicable standards.

Reference Letter - Kelly Services (Canada) Ltd., Mississauga ON. Taner Yildirim is currently employed as English-Turkish Interpreter, working at Languageline LLC. Full-time 30 hours per week, remote, Ontario. $19.50/hour, start date March 11 2024, ongoing.
Duties:
- Provides on-demand interpreter service over the phone
- Interprets conversations between individuals with limited English language skills and representatives from Healthcare, Insurance, Financial, and Law Enforcement industries
- Performs interpretation in consecutive mode, rendering spoken communication from one language to another after each speaker completes their turn
- Renders correct concepts and meanings according to established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions
- Maintains professional demeanor throughout audio interpreting sessions
- Remains calm during sessions involving incoherent or upset speakers, including emergency situations such as 911 calls
- All interpretation conducted over the phone using professional equipment in accordance with industry standards
